info.title: Brai private GigaAM v3 e2e CTC runner
info.description: Private UTF-8 JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdin/stdout, one JSON document per line. stdout contains RPC responses only; stderr contains diagnostics. GigaAM, VAD model, and audio paths are local to the service container.

methods.name: health
methods.summary: Return the loaded model readiness and immutable revision.

methods.name: transcribe
methods.summary: Transcribe local audio with GigaAM-v3 e2e CTC, switching to VAD longform above 25 seconds.

schema.description: Absolute local path to an FFmpeg-decodable audio file readable by the runner.

errors.message: Audio file is unavailable, invalid, or exceeds the configured longform duration limit

x-transport.type: UTF-8 JSON text lines over child-process stdin/stdout
x-transport.request: JSON-RPC 2.0 request object, or batch array, on one line
x-transport.response: JSON-RPC 2.0 result or error object on one line
x-transport.batch: One response array line in request order; notifications are omitted; all-notification batch emits no line
x-transport.offline: GigaAM and pyannote VAD are loaded from checksum-verified local snapshots; runtime network access is disabled.

x-jsonrpc-errors.-32600: Invalid request; id is null when the request id cannot be determined
x-jsonrpc-errors.-32601: Method not found; recognized request id is echoed
x-jsonrpc-errors.-32602: Invalid params; recognized request id is echoed
x-jsonrpc-errors.-32001: Audio input unavailable, undecodable, or beyond configured longform duration limit
x-jsonrpc-errors.-32603: Internal or inference error; sensitive implementation details are omitted

x-resource-lifecycle: The runner owns one CPU model for its process lifetime. Exiting the child process releases its model memory; there is no unload RPC.
